title: Document management
goal: Model document-owned pages and versions alongside retained folders and access grants.

rubric.must: Document has filled composition diamonds to Page and Version, each with 1..* multiplicity.
Folder has a hollow aggregation diamond to Document rather than a filled composition diamond.
AccessGrant has directed associations to both Permission and Document.
SearchIndex has a dashed dependency arrow to Document.
Permission is visibly an enumeration with READ, WRITE, and ADMIN literals.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the umlclass exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target visibly matches all five rubric rules. Relationships and labels are traceable, and no material overlaps or cropping are apparent.

items.evidence: Document connects to Page and Version with filled composition diamonds at Document and 1 to 1..* multiplicities.
Folder connects to Document with a hollow aggregation diamond at Folder; the Document end shows 0..*.
AccessGrant has directed associations to Document (grants access to) and Permission.
SearchIndex connects to Document with a dashed dependency arrow pointing to Document, labeled indexes.
Permission is marked as an enumeration and lists READ, WRITE, and ADMIN.
